title: security-eng-sync-notes-2026-03-10
content:
Meeting: Security Engineering Sync
Date: 2026-03-10
Time: 10:00-10:45 PT
Attendees: Aisha Patel (owner), Ethan Kim, Lina Martinez, Tom Walker, Priya Desai, guest: Dev - Javier
Notes:
1) Agenda
- Quick rundown of active vuln triage
- Secrets scan findings and immediate mitigations
- Threat modeling: persisted KV cache feature (design review)
- Ops/incident backlog and on-call handoff
- Action items and owners

2) Vulnerability triage
- JIRA-4321: CVE-2026-1458 in dependency 'faststore' used by serving-runtime
  - Severity: High (RCE via deserialization in plugin parser)
  - Reported: 2026-03-09 by external researcher
  - Current status: reproducer built by Ethan; PoC limited to dev env
  - Mitigation: patch vendor pinned version -> 2.1.4 (security release). Temporary workaround: disable plugin parser for untrusted inputs.
  - Owners: Ethan Kim (patch + PR), Lina Martinez (release coord)
  - ETA: patch PR by 2026-03-11 EOD, deploy to staging 03-12, canary 03-13
  - Notes: need to coordinate Dedicated customers on minimal downtime windows; Priya to draft customer notification template.

- JIRA-4390: privilege escalation in internal admin console session fixation
  - Severity: Medium
  - Status: assigned to Tom; reproducer flaky
  - Next: Tom to add improved logging and repro steps by 03-12; potential mitigation is rotating admin session cookie secrets and deploying CSRF hardening.

3) Secrets scan results (weekly run: 2026-03-09)
- Findings summary: 6 new potential secrets flagged; 4 false positives (test fixtures), 2 confirmed (AWS keys in legacy deployment repo)
  - Confirmed: aws-access-key id AKIA**** found in repo infra/legacy-deploy (archived)
  - Mitigation: rotate keys immediately, remove from repo, add repo to denylist for scanner, create PR to scrub git history
  - Owners: Priya Desai (rotate keys + notify cloud infra), Javier (cleanup PR), SRE to update IAM policies
  - ETA: rotation + notification 03-11
- Action: update scanner rules to reduce false positive rate for fixture patterns (Lina)
- Short-term: new pre-commit hook enforced on primary infra repos by 03-17

4) Threat modeling: persisted KV cache for inference-serving (design review)
- Feature: persistent local KV cache to improve cold-start latencies for dedicated pools (proposal link: CON-1234)
- Threats discussed:
  - Unauthorized access to persisted KV (sensitive prefix tokens in cache)
  - Data leakage between tenants in shared hardware
  - Disk-level exfiltration if node compromised
  - Replay attacks using stale KV entries
- Mitigations proposed:
  - Encrypt on-disk with per-customer envelope keys (KMS integration) — Lina to provide integration checklist
  - Per-tenant namespaces + mandatory cache zeroization on allocation change
  - Audit logs for cache access with sampling and alerting for abnormal read patterns
  - Short TTL for sensitive prefixes, explicit opt-in for caching PII
- Open questions:
  - Can we reuse existing KMS tenant keys or need new key rotation cadence? (Action: Security research to confirm by 03-16)
  - Performance trade-offs for encryption layer — bench with sample workload (Action: Serving-runtime team to run perf job by 03-19)

5) Ops / incident backlog
- Follow-ups from last week's incident: postmortem draft in CON-1210, still pending SRE comments
  - Aisha to chase SRE for finalizing postmortem by 03-12
- On-call escalation thresholds: agreed to lower P50 latency alert for Dedicated by 10% temporarily
  - Config PR: infra/alerts#101 (Tom) targeting 03-12

6) Customer/enterprise notes
- Priya working on customer notification template for CVE-2026-1458; include mitigations, expected timeline, and dedicated customer support contact
- For Dedicated customers with strict maintenance windows, Lina to collect UTC windows by 03-12

7) Action items (owner — due)
- Ethan Kim — submit patch PR for faststore (JIRA-4321) — 2026-03-11
- Lina Martinez — coordinate release and customer windows, update scanner rules — 2026-03-12 / 2026-03-17
- Priya Desai — rotate exposed AWS keys and notify customers/cloud infra — 2026-03-11
- Tom Walker — improve admin console logging + alerts, submit config PR for Dedicated alerts — 2026-03-12
- Javier (dev) — open PR to scrub git history of legacy repo and add denylist — 2026-03-11
- Security research (unassigned) — confirm KMS key reuse and rotation cadence for KV cache — 2026-03-16
- Serving-runtime bench team — perf run for on-disk encryption overhead — 2026-03-19

8) Parking lot / other notes
- Consider adding signed cache entries to prevent replayed KVs across restarts
- Revisit secrets scanning frequency for archived repos (weekly vs. daily)
- Quick wins: add clearer scanner rule for test fixture patterns to reduce noise

9) Next meeting
- Weekly security eng sync: 2026-03-17 10:00 PT

References and links:
- Confluence: CON-1234 (KV cache design), CON-1210 (last incident postmortem)
- GitHub: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/789 (alert config draft)
- JIRA: JIRA-4321, JIRA-4390

Notes-to-self: ping legal about required disclosure timeline if exploit observed by external parties. Keep candidate CVE timeline tracked.
